contradictions.finding: SDK header/SVD and PAC contain INIT +0x10; UM V1.5 chapter10 lists CR/DR/RESULT only and fixed seeds; own SDK crc.c never uses INIT.
contradictions.policy: No arbitrary-seed API or INIT access. Document uncertainty, do not call register fictitious.

contradictions.finding: chip metadata associates IRQ31 FAULT with CRC. UM V1.4 §4.7.9 p75 and §5.4 p94 explicitly assign FAULT to HSE/LSE run failure under SYSCTRL.
contradictions.policy: Future curated metadata correction; retain FAULT vector, move ownership to SYSCTRL. CRC polling only.

contradictions.finding: PAC fields have generic descriptions. All reviewed manuals document EN one-way set, IE one-way set, and SR.POV write-zero-clear.
contradictions.policy: Do not use generated generic modify semantics to invent disable/clear behavior; annotate curated descriptions in future authorized batch.
